name: Necromancy Rituals — 2 Intermediate — Occhio d'Uomo Morto

system.description: Using an eye taken from a corpse whose soul became a wraith (or spectre), the Necromancer ritually removes one of her own eyes and replaces it with the corpse's eye, which Kindred healing seals into the socket. On success the Necromancer permanently gains Shroudsight with no roll required. If the eye came from a spettro corpse, she can also faintly overhear area spettri (a Perception + Occult roll for a vague impression; a botch may inflict a derangement). Drawbacks: permanent -1 Appearance, +1 difficulty to mundane visual Perception, but a one-Trait resolution bonus against Dominate and Serpentis: Eyes of the Serpent (and similar eye-contact powers). The ghost whose eye was taken can always locate the Necromancer and gains a one-Trait bonus using any of its powers against her.
system.source: Clanbook: Giovanni, Chapter Two: It Runs in the Family
